verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs say you can connect GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket to deploy on every push, with a preview URL for every branch. The official repo README confirms the workflow ('git push to deploy'). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of push-triggered deploys, and in-depth documentation (only summary-level snippets) on branch/production mapping and trigger configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push
